OUR PHILOSOPHY
"The modern smartphone industry is obsessed with artificial benchmarks and gimmick sensors. We believe in honest hardware."
01

The Death of the 2MP Macro Gimmick

We penalize phones that pad their spec sheets with useless 2-megapixel macro and depth sensors. A single high-grade 50MP Sony or Samsung sensor with hardware OIS is worth ten cheap decorative lenses.

02

Flat Displays Over Curved Frustration

Curved displays cause edge glare, accidental palm touches, and fragile drop angles. Flat AMOLED displays provide superior tactile accuracy and perfect edge-to-edge screen protector adhesion.

03

Zero Tolerance for Notification Spam

A daily driver should be a calm, reliable tool—not an ad real-estate billboard. We champion operating systems with zero preloaded junkware and clean system architecture.
